info.title: Rightmo Product API
info.description: Product catalogue REST API: authentication, categories, products, product images and product ratings.

password.description: Min 8 chars with uppercase, lowercase, number and symbol (@$!%*#?&)

post.summary: Login and get an access token

get.summary: List all categories (sorted by name, cached)
List products with average rating and first image (paginated, searchable, filterable, sortable, cached)

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: rating = average rating (unrated products count as lowest)

post.summary: Create a product with optional images

images[].description: Up to 10 images (jpg, jpeg, png, webp, max 2MB each)

get.summary: Get a product with category, all images, average rating and rating count (cached)

put.summary: Update a product (images are managed with the Product Images endpoints)

schema.description: Send only the fields to change

delete.summary: Delete a product with its images and ratings

images[].description: 1 to 10 images (jpg, jpeg, png, webp, max 2MB each)

post.description: The route is PUT, but PHP cannot read files from a multipart PUT request, so send POST with `_method=PUT` (Laravel method spoofing).

image.description: jpg, jpeg, png or webp, max 2MB

404.description: Image not found for this product
Image not found for this product

get.summary: List ratings of a product (newest first)

post.description: A user may rate the same product several times; every call creates a new rating.

put.description: Only the user who wrote the rating can update it. Send only the fields to change.

403.description: The rating belongs to another user

message.example: You can only change your own ratings.

404.description: The rating does not exist for this product

delete.description: Only the user who wrote the rating can delete it.

403.description: The rating belongs to another user

message.example: You can only change your own ratings.

404.description: The rating does not exist for this product

price.description: Decimal with 2 places, returned as a string

average_rating.description: Average rating rounded to 1 decimal, 0 when not rated

ProductListItem.description: Product in the list: first image only (use GET /products/{productId} for description, all images, rating count and dates)

price.description: Decimal with 2 places, returned as a string

average_rating.description: Average rating rounded to 1 decimal, 0 when not rated

image_url.description: URL of the first image, null when the product has no images

errors.description: Field name => list of error messages

message.example: Unauthenticated. Please login and send a valid Bearer token.

errors.description: Exception message (only when APP_DEBUG is true)

sanctum.description: Sanctum personal access token from /auth/login or /auth/register. Enter only the token (without "Bearer").

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Product CRUD with search, filter, sort and pagination

tags.name: Product Images
tags.description: Add, replace and delete product images

tags.name: Product Ratings
tags.description: Rate products (1 to 5) and list ratings
